origin.description: Build a glsStruct model structure from optional correlation and variance components.
origin.details: NULL components are dropped. The class vector is glsStruct and modelStruct.
origin.value: A glsStruct object (list of the non-NULL components).
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(nlme))
fm <- glsStruct(corStruct = corAR1(0.2, form = ~ 1 | Mare))
print(names(fm))
print(class(fm))
print(length(fm))

translation.description: Build a GlsStruct holding the non-None components in order.

arguments.name: corStruct
arguments.text: a correlation structure object or None

arguments.name: varStruct
arguments.text: a variance function object or None

translation.details: Initialize.glsStruct is not translated yet: it needs gls_estimate from nlmefit.c, which has no crate.
translation.value: A GlsStruct with components, names, corStruct, varStruct, classes, and len.
translation.example:
from nlme.corar1 import corAR1
from nlme.glsstruct import glsStruct

fm = glsStruct(corStruct=corAR1(0.2, form="~ 1 | Mare"))
print(fm.names)
print(fm.classes)
print(len(fm))
